2|# Copyright 2019 Google Inc.

15|#
16|################################################################################
17|
18|# build project
19|if [ "$SANITIZER" = undefined ]; then
20|    export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fno-sanitize=unsigned-integer-overflow"
21|    export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -fno-sanitize=unsigned-integer-overflow"
22|fi
23|cd binutils-gdb
24|
25|# Comment out the lines of logging to stderror from elfcomm.c
26|# This is to make it nicer to read the output of libfuzzer.
27|cd binutils
28|sed -i 's/vfprintf (stderr/\/\//' elfcomm.c
29|sed -i 's/fprintf (stderr/\/\//' elfcomm.c
30|cd ../
31|
32|./configure --disable-gdb --disable-gdbserver --disable-gdbsupport \
33|	    --disable-libdecnumber --disable-readline --disable-sim \
34|	    --disable-libbacktrace --disable-gas --disable-ld --disable-werror \
35|      --enable-targets=all
36|make clean
37|make MAKEINFO=true && true
38|
39|
40|# Make fuzzer directory
41|mkdir fuzz
42|cp ../fuzz_*.c fuzz/
43|cd fuzz
44|
45|LIBS="../opcodes/libopcodes.a ../libctf/.libs/libctf.a ../bfd/libbfd.a ../zlib/libz.a ../libiberty/libiberty.a"
46|for i in fuzz_disassemble fuzz_bfd fuzz_bfd_ext; do
47|    $CC $CFLAGS -I ../include -I ../bfd -I ../opcodes -c $i.c -o $i.o
48|    $CXX $CXXFLAGS $i.o -o $OUT/$i $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE -Wl,--start-group ${LIBS} -Wl,--end-group
49|done
50|
51|# Build targeted disassembly fuzzers
52|if [ -n "${OSS_FUZZ_CI-}" ]
53|then
54|  echo "Skipping specialised disassembly fuzzers in CI to reduce build time"
55|else
56|  for ARCH_TARGET in bfd_arch_arm bfd_arch_mips bfd_arch_i386 bfd_arch_arc bfd_arch_csky bfd_arch_mep; do
57|      $CC $CFLAGS -I ../include -I ../bfd -I ../opcodes -c fuzz_disas_ext.c -DFUZZ_TARGET_ARCH=$ARCH_TARGET \
58|        -o fuzz_disas_ext-$ARCH_TARGET.o
59|      $CXX $CXXFLAGS fuzz_disas_ext-$ARCH_TARGET.o -o $OUT/fuzz_disas_ext-$ARCH_TARGET $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE \
60|        -Wl,--start-group ${LIBS} -Wl,--end-group
61|  done
62|fi
63|
64|# Now compile the src/binutils fuzzers
65|cd ../binutils
66|
67|# Compile the fuzzers.
68|# The general strategy is to remove main functions such that the fuzzer (which has its own main)
69|# can link against the code.
70|
71|# Copy over precondition files
72|cp $SRC/binutils-preconditions/*.h .
73|
74|#
75|# Patching
76|#
77|# First do readelf. We do this by changing readelf.c to readelf.h - the others will be changed
78|# to fuzz_readelf.h where readelf is their respective name. The reason it's different for readelf
79|# is because readelf does not have a header file so we can use readelf.h instead, and changing it
80|# might cause an annoyance on monorail since bugs will be relocated as the files will be different.
81|cp ../../fuzz_*.c .
82|sed 's/main (int argc/old_main (int argc, char **argv);\nint old_main (int argc/' readelf.c >> readelf.h
83|
84|# Special handling of dlltool
85|sed 's/main (int ac/old_main32 (int ac, char **av);\nint old_main32 (int ac/' dlltool.c > fuzz_dlltool.h
86|sed -i 's/copy_mian/copy_main/g' fuzz_dlltool.h
87|
88|# Patch the rest
89|for i in objdump nm objcopy windres strings addr2line; do
90|    sed -i 's/strip_main/strip_mian/g' $i.c
91|    sed -i 's/copy_main/copy_mian/g' $i.c
92|    sed 's/main (int argc/old_main32 (int argc, char **argv);\nint old_main32 (int argc/' $i.c > fuzz_$i.h
93|    sed -i 's/copy_mian/copy_main/g' fuzz_$i.h
94|done
95|
96|#
97|# Compile fuzzers
98|#
99|fuzz_compile () {
100|  src=$1
101|  dst=$2
102|  extraflags=$3
103|  $CC $CFLAGS ${extraflags} -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -DOBJDUMP_PRIVATE_VECTORS="" -I. -I../bfd -I./../bfd -I./../include \
104|    -I./../zlib -DLOCALEDIR="\"/usr/local/share/locale\"" \
105|    -Dbin_dummy_emulation=bin_vanilla_emulation -W -Wall -MT \
106|    fuzz_$dst.o -MD -MP -c -o fuzz_$dst.o fuzz_$src.c
107|}
108|for i in objdump readelf nm objcopy windres ranlib_simulation strings addr2line dwarf; do
109|  fuzz_compile $i $i ""
110|done
111|
112|# Fuzzers that need additional flags
113|fuzz_compile dlltool dlltool "-DDLLTOOL_I386 -DDLLTOOL_DEFAULT_I386"
114|fuzz_compile objdump objdump_safe "-DOBJDUMP_SAFE"
115|fuzz_compile readelf readelf_pef "-DREADELF_TARGETED=\"pef\""
116|fuzz_compile readelf readelf_elf32_bigarm "-DREADELF_TARGETED=\"elf32-bigarm\""
117|fuzz_compile readelf readelf_elf32_littlearm "-DREADELF_TARGETED=\"elf32-littlearm\""
118|fuzz_compile readelf readelf_elf64_mmix "-DREADELF_TARGETED=\"elf64-mmix\""
119|fuzz_compile readelf readelf_elf32_csky "-DREADELF_TARGETED=\"elf32-csky\""
120|
121|#
122|# Link fuzzers
123|#
124|# Link the files, but only if everything went well, which we verify by checking
125|# the presence of some object files.
126|LINK_LIBS="-Wl,--start-group ${LIBS} -Wl,--end-group"
127|OBJ1="bucomm.o version.o filemode.o"
128|OBJ2="version.o unwind-ia64.o dwarf.o elfcomm.o demanguse.o"
129|OBJ3="dwarf.o prdbg.o rddbg.o unwind-ia64.o debug.o stabs.o rdcoff.o bucomm.o version.o filemode.o elfcomm.o od-xcoff.o demanguse.o"
130|
131|declare -A fl
132|fl["readelf"]=${OBJ2}
133|fl["readelf_pef"]=${OBJ2}
134|fl["readelf_elf32_bigarm"]=${OBJ2}
135|fl["readelf_elf32_littlearm"]=${OBJ2}
136|fl["readelf_elf64_mmix"]=${OBJ2}
137|fl["readelf_elf32_csky"]=${OBJ2}
138|fl["objdump"]=${OBJ3}
139|fl["objdump_safe"]=${OBJ3}
140|fl["dwarf"]=${OBJ3}
141|fl["addr2line"]=${OBJ1}
142|fl["objcopy"]="is-strip.o rename.o rddbg.o debug.o stabs.o rdcoff.o wrstabs.o ${OBJ1}"
143|fl["nm"]="${OBJ1} demanguse.o"
144|fl["dlltool"]="defparse.o deflex.o ${OBJ1}"
145|fl["windres"]="resrc.o rescoff.o resbin.o rcparse.o rclex.o winduni.o resres.o ${OBJ1}"
146|fl["ranlib_simulation"]=" "
147|fl["strings"]=${OBJ1}
148|for fuzzer in ${!fl[@]}; do
149|  $CXX $CXXFLAGS $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE -W -Wall -I./../zlib \
150|    -o $OUT/fuzz_${fuzzer} fuzz_${fuzzer}.o \
151|    ${fl[${fuzzer}]} ${LINK_LIBS}
152|done
153|
154|# Build GAS fuzzer. Will keep this here in case GAS fuzzer is used in the future.
155|if [ "$FUZZING_ENGINE" != "afl" ]
156|then
157|  cd ../gas
158|  ./configure
159|  make
160|  sed 's/main (int argc/old_main32 (int argc, char **argv);\nint old_main32 (int argc/' as.c > fuzz_as.h
161|  rm as.o || true
162|  ar r libar.a *.o
163|
164|  $CC $CFLAGS -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -I.  -I. -I. -I../bfd -I./config -I./../include -I./.. -I./../bfd \
165|      -DLOCALEDIR="\"/usr/local/share/locale\"" -I./../zlib -c $SRC/fuzz_as.c -o fuzz_as.o
166|  $CXX $CXXFLAGS $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE -I./../zlib -o $OUT/fuzz_as ./fuzz_as.o \
167|      libar.a config/tc-i386.o config/obj-elf.o config/atof-ieee.o  \
168|      ../opcodes/.libs/libopcodes.a ../bfd/.libs/libbfd.a \
169|      -L/src/binutils-gdb/zlib ../libiberty/libiberty.a -lz
170|fi
171|
172|# Copy seeds out
173|for fuzzname in readelf_pef readelf_elf32_csky readelf_elf64_mmix readelf_elf32_littlearm readelf_elf32_bigarm objdump objdump_safe nm objcopy bdf windres addr2line dwarf; do
174|  cp $SRC/binary-samples/oss-fuzz-binutils/general_seeds.zip $OUT/fuzz_${fuzzname}_seed_corpus.zip
175|done
176|# Seed targeted the pef file format
177|cp $SRC/binary-samples/oss-fuzz-binutils/fuzz_bfd_ext_seed_corpus.zip $OUT/fuzz_bfd_ext_seed_corpus.zip
178|
179|# Copy options files
180|for ft in readelf readelf_pef readelf_elf32_csky readelf_elf64_mmix readelf_elf32_littlearm readelf_elf32_bigarm objcopy objdump dlltool disas_ext-bfd_arch_csky nm as windres objdump_safe ranlib_simulation addr2line dwarf; do
181|  echo "[libfuzzer]" > $OUT/fuzz_${ft}.options
182|  echo "detect_leaks=0" >> $OUT/fuzz_${ft}.options
183|done
